title: LocalBackupCoordinator.bootstrapAtLaunch never runs a launch-time history catch-up

description: Discovered during Wave 5c (flagged in its closing report, filed by orchestrator). Unlike the other two history consumers, LocalBackupCoordinator only advances its watermark from a live NSPersistentStoreRemoteChange notification - bootstrapAtLaunch() never calls processRemoteChange() as an explicit catch-up. 5c's registry-gated pruner already prevents the X12 data-loss consequence (a stale watermark blocks the sweep), but the stale watermark can now cause unbounded history growth if no notification fires. Fix shape: call the catch-up during bootstrap like RemoteChangeReconciler/DiagnosticHistoryObserver do (consumer-discipline pattern from 4a). Details in plan-5c doc section 7.
